strategies.name: opening_range_fvg_retest_scalp
strategies.entry_summary: On the 5-minute chart, mark the high and low of the first 9:30-9:35 candle. strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop just beyond the deepest point traded into the fair value gap, with one tick of breathing room. Take profit at a fixed 3:1 reward-to-risk target and do not micromanage the trade.

strategies.name: opening_range_fvg_limit_reentry_day_trade
strategies.entry_summary: On the 15-minute chart, mark the high and low of the first 9:30-9:45 candle. On the 5-minute chart, wait for price to break one of those levels with a fair value gap, then place a limit order at the fair value gap so that a trade is triggered automatically when price retraces into it.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop at the first candle of the fair value gap pattern. Take profit at a fixed 2:1 reward-to-risk target and let the trade play out without micromanaging it.

result.enumeration_note: The video teaches two distinct but compatible strategies: a scalping FVG retest entry with engulfing confirmation and 3:1 target, and a day-trading FVG limit-entry variant using different timeframe, confirmation mechanic, and 2:1 target; these could be grouped under Rule 3, but are enumerated separately with their distinctives preserved.
